page.notes: Doubtful readings: the left-margin note beside "Bellum" ("P.R.ibaden.lef." and "vita Leonis") is uncertain; the date "Ioccccxvii" is read as MCCCCXVII, and "cIↄcccLvi" as MCCCLVI. The asterisks in "* Otho" and "*attigimus" are printed marks, not letters. The catchword "clarat," follows the last line. The last line "satis de-" is a broken word and continues on the next page. Printed spelling kept, including "senfit", "posteà" and "Rom.priùs". The watermark at the foot ("Digitized by Google") is left out.
